sources.snippet: Qwen3-30B-A3B is a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) large language model developed by Alibaba, featuring 30B total parameters with 3B active parameters. It employs Grouped-Query Attention (GQA) and Qwen3MoE architecture, with support for EAGLE3 speculative decoding for accelerated inference.
